changelog:
Initial release of "Smoke Test" skill for web application QA workflow.

- Provides an iterative, five-phase QA and fixing workflow for comprehensive web app quality assurance.
- Covers functional testing (all views, DOM assertions, API truth comparison, forbidden-string scanning), root cause analysis, code-level fixes, regression verification, and evidence-chain reporting.
- Includes automation script templates, backup/rollback protocols, and multi-level verification schemes.
- Usable on any web application, with guidance for both frontend and backend technologies.
- Supports both English and Chinese usage and documentation.
summary: 多模态大模型辅助的 Web 应用「测试—修复」迭代工作流：覆盖全面测试（全视图、DOM 断言、API 真值比对、禁止串扫描）、根因审核、代码级修复、回归验证与证据链报告。当用户要做测试、回归、修复验证、功能测试或冒烟测试时触发。
